decisions.reason: The product builds directly on the firm's modular waste-processing knowledge and shows strong quantified customer savings, so absorptive capacity is high and the firm can learn and improve it.
The slow-speed shredder is close to existing material-processing know-how and has a dedicated web presence, but early results are less quantified, so a moderate chance of dropping remains.
As the flagship modular product line with several models, it aligns with the firm's stated direction and existing modular solutions, giving high absorptive capacity and strategic reason to keep.

The trommel screen is related to screening within material processing, yet its brief mention and weaker early evidence make it somewhat more likely to be pruned than the core modular and flagship products.
